**Preparing for screenshot**

I need to take a screenshot after a gesture, so I’ll use kind=touch and call ext.nothingness.screenshot with pixelRatio set to 1.0. It’s important to save the image. I must remember to clear any feedback after the gesture, capturing the screenshot right after the drag action. I'll save it to /workspace/.tmp/seek_post.png—sounds straightforward, but I want to make sure everything’s in order for the final output!

arguments.command:
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; D=.claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py;
$D call ext.nothingness.screenshot pixelRatio=1.0 > /workspace/.tmp/screenshot_post.json;
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,base64
res=json.load(open('/workspace/.tmp/screenshot_post.json'))
open('/workspace/.tmp/seek_post.png','wb').write(base64.b64decode(res['png_base64']))
print('wrote /workspace/.tmp/seek_post.png',res.get('width'),res.get('height'))
PY
